title: Nutrypollo
description: nutrypollo.com.mx zoominfo.com/c/nutrypollo/427100153 Nutrypollo / Agroindustrias Quesada, S. de R.L. de C.V. is a Mexican family-owned poultry company (4th generation) based in Aguascalientes; it began as Bernardo Quesada de Alba's egg-laying farm in 1950 and entered broiler production in 1963 under founder Jorge Quesada Morán. It is fully vertically integrated — genetics and hatching, feed milling, grow-out farms, slaughter and processing (12,000 birds/hour, up to 80,000 birds/day, ~60 million birds a year) and distribution across 30+ Mexican states. Brands include fresh chicken under Nutrypollo, the marinated Nutryfácil and Premium lines, and, since November 2023, its own NutryTienda retail concept.
